title: Mass Effect 2
setupHint: Start Mass Effect 2 once, or select Player1.prf in Settings.
pathPlaceholder: Path to Documents\BioWare\Mass Effect 2\BIOGame\Profile\Player1.prf (or that folder)
trackingNote: Mass Effect 2 on PC records its achievements in its own profile (Documents\BioWare\Mass Effect 2\BIOGame\Profile\Player1.prf, shared by all characters), the same list it shows under Extras. The plugin reads that file, so 61 achievements, DLC included, unlock by themselves a few seconds after the game records them. Highly Trained is an Xbox 360 achievement the PC game doesn't have, so it is marked by hand.
autoTag: Unlocks automatically from your Mass Effect 2 profile
